gbm_population_evidence.quote: Dose escalation portion: patients with recurrent high-grade glioma, IDH wt or IDH mutated, grade 3 or grade 4 based on imaging.
Dose expansion portion: Recurrent, IDH wt, glioblastoma, WHO grade 4.

candidate_evidence.quote: MVR-C5252 is a genetically modified next generation oncolytic herpes simplex virus 1 (oHSV1)

role_evidence.quote: MVR-C5252 is a genetically modified next generation oncolytic herpes simplex virus 1 (oHSV1)

agents.drug_class_hint: oncolytic HSV-1 encoding human IL-12 and an anti-PD-1 Fab fragment, given by convection-enhanced delivery
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Expresses IL-12 and anti-PD-1 antibody in the tumour microenvironment, increasing T cell infiltration and inducing anti-tumour immunity

source_quote.quote: Dose expansion portion: Recurrent, IDH wt, glioblastoma, WHO grade 4.

coder_notes: Oncolytic virus only, so excluded at S6. Conditions say recurrent high grade glioma; glioblastoma is named in the inclusion criteria for the dose-expansion cohort. IDH-wildtype is a diagnostic criterion for that cohort. Gadolinium used with the infusion is mentioned only in the description and not listed.
